name: Hikari to Kage no Michishirube II
source:
The fight between the light and the dark.
There we could recognize a blond-haired strong female fencer.
What kind of fate awaits her who is captivated?
This is a novelized software version of the doujinshi series.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE050874.html]DLsite English[/url]]

光明与黑暗之间的斗争。
在那里我们可以认出一位金发强壮的女击剑手。
被迷住的她将会面临怎样的命运？
这是同人志系列的小说软件版本。
